topic_title: Definition of Traffic Flow & Operational Dynamics
prompt: What primary driver behavior triggers sudden phantom traffic slowdowns on congested Texas freeways?

options.text: Maintaining a generous three-second following distance behind large pickup trucks
Signaling intent at least one hundred feet prior to initiating highway lane changes
Scanning roadway shoulders twelve seconds ahead for unexpected roadside hazards
Tailgating leading to abrupt panic braking that cascades backward through traffic
